description:
Use this setting to control how much of your total licensed Full-Stack trace volume is allocated to [Adaptive Traffic Management](https://dt-url.net/jk036gk) (ATM) as usable adaptive trace volume. This includes any additionally configured [extended trace volume](https://dt-url.net/nf233j7). 

This self-service capability lets you reduce your usable Full-Stack trace volume when it’s not needed. 

For instance, you might request extended ingest for major events – say, five times your included trace volume – and then, once the event is over, **reduce the** [usable adaptive trace volume](https://dt-url.net/p7436hg) **percentage** to 30% to reduce [extended trace ingest](https://dt-url.net/nf233j7) coming from the OneAgent. 

You might also ingest OpenTelemetry traces that originate from a Full-Stack monitored host or application. These traces benefit from the [Full-Stack included trace volume](https://dt-url.net/2m636ur), but cannot be adaptively sampled by Adaptive Traffic Management as OpenTelemetry traces are usually rate-limited (e.g., 500 per minute) or sampled at fixed rates (e.g., 50%). Therefore, they can exceed the included trace volume. 

Reducing the [usable adaptive trace volume](https://dt-url.net/p7436hg) to, e.g., 50% will free up half of the available volume for OpenTelemetry trace data, reducing the amount of traces charged as [Traces - Ingest & Process](https://dt-url.net/8d036w2), making this also an efficient cost-control mechanism.  

For more details about this new control, see [Adaptive Traffic Management with Dynatrace Platform Subscription IDPS](https://dt-url.net/t5836j8). For more details about how to configure new settings, see [Settings API](https://dt-url.net/hqe3610).

usableAdaptiveTraceVolumePercentage.description: The default setting of 100% allows ATM to distribute all usable adaptive volume to the agents. Setting 50% limits distribution to half of the usable adaptive volume. The minimum configurable percentage is 1%.
usableAdaptiveTraceVolumePercentage.documentation: A value of 80% means that 80% of the usable adaptive volume is distributed to the agents, while the remaining 20% is not used for adaptive sampling and could be reserved for, e.g., fixed-rate sampling.
